name: Simulate Binaural
description: Simulate binaural room impulse responses, an HRTF per path and per delay line: image sources, optional edge diffraction around obstacles and at the edges of the room's boundary that open wider than 180 deg, and a directional feedback delay network tail. Needs the worker (Python >= 3.11) and a closed room. Writes the responses to the impulse response graph under 'binaural'.

inputParameters.name: tail
inputParameters.description: Decay target of the tail: auto (reference if given, else ray_tracing), reference, ray_tracing (its own ray-traced reference), eyring or sabine (predicted, no simulation).

inputParameters.name: reference
inputParameters.description: Optional reference for the tail: connect the irs output of Simulate Mono, simulated for the same scene, one response per source and receiver (the wire also makes Grasshopper run the ray tracing first).

inputParameters.name: ism_order
inputParameters.description: Highest image source order in the early field.

inputParameters.name: diffraction
inputParameters.description: Edge diffraction around obstacles and at the edges of the room's boundary that open wider than 180 deg: none (default), udfa, or btms (slow).

inputParameters.name: late_envelope
inputParameters.description: How the late field follows the reference: auto (omni with a reference or ray-traced tail, off for an Eyring or Sabine tail), omni (its level per band to the reference's late energy), directional (as omni, and each delay line to its direction's share of the ray-traced energy), or off.

inputParameters.name: n_rays
inputParameters.description: Number of rays per source of the rays the method traces itself: the reference of a ray_tracing tail, or the directional histograms of a given reference. Empty (default): Vorlaender's count for a direction's energy to 1 dB from the room's volume, at least 20000, as Simulate Mono takes by default. A larger number gives a smoother tail at a longer run. Not used, with a remark, when the method traces no rays (an Eyring or Sabine tail, or a given reference without a directional late envelope).

inputParameters.name: seed
inputParameters.description: Seed of the feedback matrices, the delay jitter and the rays the method traces, 42 as in the method: the same seed gives the same responses, and Simulate Binaural and Simulate Ambisonics up to SH order 3 the same late field; another number gives another realisation.

inputParameters.name: normalize
inputParameters.description: Whether the impulse responses are peak-normalised (default True). The raw level is always kept.

inputParameters.name: hrtf
inputParameters.description: HRTF set of the binaural responses. Empty: Neumann KU 100 (default). Choose a .sofa file with the HRTF... button, or connect a File Path to one, which takes precedence; the component's message names the set in use.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: Simulate when true: the body's Run button, or a Button or Boolean Toggle wired here. The simulation takes seconds to minutes and Grasshopper recomputes on every change of the inputs, so it starts only on a press; otherwise the responses of the last run for this scene are passed on.

outputParameters.name: irs
outputParameters.description: The binaural impulse responses, one per source and receiver in scene order (receiver by receiver, sources within each). Connect them to Analyse Impulse Response, Audio Player or Auralise.
